notes.title: Nominate OFK Please! 🙏🏼
notes.notes:
It's fancy award season!! Did you love our music? Our story? Our visuals? PLEASE consider nominating us above! Award nominations help us get the word out to more people about our story... and Debug deserves a trophy right? RIGHT?

We'd especially love a nomination for...
🏆 Best Soundtrack
🏆 Outstanding Story-Rich Game
because we think we might stand a chance against the MEGA BIG GAMES with huge marketing departments! But please pick whatever you feel :)

MORE NEWS REALLY SOON ACTUALLY

xoox,
OFK

notes.title: We Are OFK // Episode 5 Out Now! // SEASON FINALE
notes.notes:
We made it!!! Episode 5 is Out - the final episode! If you buy (or already bought) We Are OFK, a free update is now available with our next episode! Plus an interactive music video, for the new song "thanks," from us... OFK!

It's been YEARS of a journey to get our music ready, and to get our story told. We really hope you connect with what we've been through, whether you make music, games, art, tiktoks, or any creative expression of your own!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322242/d0cf7c5cef6f8778b148ef2cff4ce99659eaa00c.png[/img]

BUT this all just the beginning! For y'all who've been with us since the start, THANK YOU for being here! For new ones, welcome. There's more to come as we work on making OFK stage performances a reality! Gonna start here in LA and see if we can get to the dream ~ a tour!

Until then, enjoy the finale, and listen to our [url=http://ofk.cool/ep]We Are OFK E.P.[/url] wherever you stream music! ALSO, [url=http://ofk.cool/score]Omniboi's Game Soundtrack[/url] just dropped too! 

Let's goooooo!! See you around! Come find us on [url=http://ofk.cool/links]our socials[/url]!

xoxo,
OFK

notes.title: Full cast revealed!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322242/77ceb92e5e9f9c1b9fdf4b5e7a36d22d4596efed.png[/img]
Hey everyone, 

Big news for us this week! We just announced our full cast for We Are OFK and we're so excited to share it with you.

The cast of [b][i]We Are OFK[/i][/b] is led by [b]Ally Maki[/b] (Toy Story 4, Dear White People) as the heartfelt and sometimes chaotic Itsumi Saitō on keyboard, [b]Syhaya Aviel[/b] (The Circle, Vinyl) as the cool and insightful Carter Flores who provides visuals for the band, [b]Fiona Rene[/b] (I Know What You Did Last Summer, ABC’s Stumptown) as the powerful music wizard Jey Zhang who is OFK’s producer, and We Are OFK’s Creative Director [b]Teddy Dief[/b] is the romantic eccentric Luca Le Fae - the vocalist. 

The full list is as follows:
[list][*] [b]Ally Maki[/b] (Toy Story 4, Dear White People)
[*] [b]Syhaya Aviel[/b] (Vinyl, The Circle)
[*] [b]Fiona Rene[/b] (ABC’s Stumptown, I Know What You Did Last Summer)

notes.title: We Are OFK is an episodic game series about a virtual band
notes.notes:
One of the best things about The Game Awards last night was its musical interludes. It was nice to break up all those game trailers with some beats to jam out to. It turns out we’ll be hearing a little more from one of the bands that performed in their own game next year, too. We Are OFK is an upcoming interactive series starring OFK, a virtual pop band working on their very first EP.

(more…)
